observation.description: The one working schema-evolution path (the dev supervisor's live watch reload) wedges permanently the moment ANY live stream subscription is attached. Repro matrix: with zero clients, or sessions-only clients, or after disposing every handle BEFORE the source swap, the reload lands 'generated-and-loaded' in under a second and data flows; with one attached live handle the reload reports 'generated-but-not-loaded' carrying SNAPBACK_AUTH_MODE_PENDING ('app-data admission is closed for an auth-mode transition'), every subsequent app-data request refuses with the same code, and admission NEVER reopens — not after the subscriber disposes (probed 20s+), with no recovery: restarting refuses on the evolved artifacts (finding f4), so the operator must restore the OLD sources to boot again. On a collaborative board, connected live clients are the steady state — the standard template (vite + browser tab open) hits this on any schema edit. The arm's workaround: dispose every provider and handle before evolving.
evidence: demos/improvement-sweep/arms/a3-snapback-web/evidence/app/repro-evolution3.mjs (scenario matrix: idle/session/preview OK, live wedges, live2 dispose-before-swap OK)

competitorOutcome.description: Convex pushes schema/function evolution to a deployment with live WebSocket subscribers attached as the normal case; subscriptions resubscribe across the push (frozen Linear-arm evidence landed its production-shaped schema change without disconnecting clients).

mustNotRegress: Admission stays closed while an artifact transition is genuinely in flight (no window where a client reads under a half-loaded catalog), and established handles never silently serve rows from a superseded schema.
smallestCoherentFix: Make the reload's auth-mode transition drain live subscriptions instead of deadlocking on them: invalidate/blank attached handles through the existing auth-invalidation protocol (clients already resubscribe), complete the transition, and reopen admission; if the transition cannot complete, roll back to the previous loaded catalog instead of leaving admission closed.
acceptanceWitness: With an attached live handle, a source edit reloads to 'generated-and-loaded'; the handle blanks or resubscribes and then receives rows under the evolved catalog; app-data admission never stays closed after the reload settles.
